item.name: 4. Document Processing & Ingestion
item.description: Document upload and processing pipeline with support for local uploads, external URLs, batch operations, and job monitoring. Supports multiple processing strategies (fast, quality, OCR) and priority levels.

item.name: Document Upload
item.description: Upload and ingest documents from local files, external URLs, or existing file IDs. Supports single and batch operations.

request.description:
Ingest existing file by ID. Requires documents:upload permission.

Processing strategies:
- fast: Quick processing, basic text extraction
- quality: Better accuracy, slower processing
- ocr: OCR for scanned documents

Priority levels: high, normal, low

Download and ingest document from external URL. Requires documents:upload permission.

Optional filename parameter to override extracted filename.

Batch ingest multiple documents from external URLs. Maximum 100 documents per batch. Requires documents:upload permission.

Each document in array can have its own strategy and matter_id.

Upload and ingest a single local file. Maximum file size: 500MB. Requires documents:upload permission.

Supports multipart/form-data upload.

item.name: Bulk Upload and Ingest Local Files

request.description: Upload and ingest multiple local files in one request. Maximum 20 files per batch, 500MB per file. Requires documents:upload permission.

item.name: Job Monitoring
item.description: Monitor and manage ingestion jobs. Check job status, list jobs, and cancel running jobs.

request.description: Get status of specific ingestion job. Returns job state (created, active, completed, failed), progress, and result.

query.description: Filter by state: created, active, completed, failed

request.description: List ingestion jobs with optional filters. Supports pagination and filtering by state, matter, or date range.
Cancel a running or pending ingestion job. Requires documents:upload permission.

item.name: Statistics & Health
item.description: Get ingestion statistics and health status

request.description: Get ingestion statistics including total jobs, success rate, processing times, and document counts. Optional filters by matter or date range.
Health check endpoint for ingestion service. Returns service status and queue health.

item.name: 5. Search & RAG
item.description: Semantic search, vector search, hybrid search, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) endpoints. Includes document search, collection management, RAG queries with LLM integration, and specialized features for concierge and librarian use cases.

item.name: Document Search
item.description: Search documents using semantic (vector), keyword, or hybrid search methods with support for filters and autocomplete.

request.description:
Main search endpoint supporting three search types:
- hybrid: Vector + keyword with RRF (default, 70% vector / 30% keyword)
- vector: Semantic search only
- keyword: Traditional keyword search only

Optional filters: document_type, case_number, bates_number, privilege_status, date_range

Requires search:query permission.

Dedicated semantic (vector) search endpoint using embeddings. Results are filtered by minimum similarity score (default 0.3).

Supports optional filters for document types, privilege status, and date range.

Dedicated hybrid search with customizable weights for vector and keyword search. Combines semantic understanding with exact keyword matching.

Default weights: 0.7 vector, 0.3 keyword

Supports filters for document types, privilege status, case number, and bates prefix.

Get autocomplete suggestions based on prefix matching.

Field options:
- all: Search across filenames, bates numbers, and content (default)
- filename: Filenames only
- bates_number: Bates numbers only
- content: Document content chunks

item.name: Collection Management
item.description: Manage pgvector collections (indexed matters) for search. Create indexes, list collections, and delete embeddings.

request.description: List all pgvector collections (matters with indexed documents). Returns document counts, chunk counts, storage size, and last update timestamp for each collection.

Create or index a matter collection. Queues document indexing jobs via pg-boss.

If reindex=true, re-indexes all documents even if already indexed.
If reindex=false, only indexes new unindexed documents.

Requires search:admin permission. Returns 202 Accepted.

Delete collection by removing all embeddings (document_chunks) for a matter. Documents themselves are not deleted.

Requires search:admin permission.

item.name: RAG Queries
item.description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) queries with LLM integration. Retrieve context and generate responses using Ollama.

body.raw:
{
  "query": "What are the key terms of the contract?",
  "client_matter": "{{matter_id}}",
  "top_k": 10,
  "document_types": ["contract"],
  "exclude_privileged": true
}

request.description:
RAG query endpoint. Retrieves relevant context from documents but does not generate LLM response. Returns document chunks with metadata.

Use this for getting context only. For LLM-generated answers, use /rag/stream.

Default: excludes privileged documents, returns top 10 results.

Document retrieval without LLM generation. Returns chunks with similarity scores, filtered by minimum score threshold.

Defaults: top_k=20, min_score=0.5, include_metadata=true

Use for pure retrieval without LLM processing.

body.raw:
{
  "query": "Summarize the key obligations in this contract",
  "client_matter": "{{matter_id}}",
  "top_k": 10,
  "document_types": ["contract"],
  "exclude_privileged": true,
  "model": "llama3.2",
  "temperature": 0.7,
  "max_tokens": 2048
}

request.description:
Streaming RAG responses via Server-Sent Events (SSE). Retrieves context and streams LLM-generated response from Ollama.

SSE Events:
- start: Connection established
- context: Retrieved chunks info
- token: Individual response tokens
- done: Generation complete with stats
- error: Error occurred

Defaults: model=llama3.2, temperature=0.7, max_tokens=2048

exec: // SSE endpoint - response is streamed, cannot validate like normal JSON
console.log("⚠️  SSE endpoint - use streaming client to test");

item.name: 6. Chat & Conversations
item.description: Chat sessions, conversation threads, memory management, and streaming responses via Server-Sent Events (SSE)

item.name: Chat Sessions
item.description: Manage chat sessions, send messages, and retrieve conversation history

request.description: List chat sessions for the current user. Supports pagination and optional matter_id filtering.
Create a new chat session. Optionally associate with a matter and provide initial context.
Get details of a specific chat session by thread ID
Update chat session metadata (e.g., rename the session)
Delete a chat session. This deletes all messages in the conversation thread, but does NOT delete the associated matter.
Send a message to a chat session. Returns a mock AI response (in production, use streaming endpoint)
Get messages from a chat session with pagination. Order can be 'asc' (oldest first) or 'desc' (newest first)

item.name: Chat Files
item.description: Upload and manage files within chat sessions

request.description: Upload files to a chat session. Supports up to 10 files, 50MB per file. Files are processed and stored with session_id metadata.
List all files uploaded to a chat session
Attach an existing file to a chat session without re-uploading
Detach a file from a chat session. The file is not deleted, only the session association is removed.

item.name: Conversation Threads
item.description: Low-level conversation thread management (alternative to chat sessions API)

request.description: Create a new conversation entry. If thread_id is not provided, a new thread will be created.
Get all messages in a conversation thread
List all conversation threads for the current user, with optional matter filtering
Delete all messages in a conversation thread

item.name: Memory Management
item.description: Create and manage conversation memories (ephemeral or long-term)

request.description: Create a memory entry. Types: 'ephemeral' (temporary) or 'long_term' (persistent). Priority: 0-10.
List memories with optional filters for type, matter, thread, and expiration
Get a specific memory by ID
Update memory content, priority, tags, or metadata
Delete a memory permanently
